meta.title: Frankencoin for exchanges and wallets: list ZCHF, add savings, share the interest
meta.description: List the decentralized Swiss franc or add savings to your wallet and receive a share of the interest your users earn, paid by the contract.

hero.title: Give your users the Swiss franc.|Earn on their savings.
hero.subtitle: List ZCHF as a standard token, or add savings to your wallet and receive a share of the interest your users earn.

why.title: What you get

items.title: Swiss franc access
items.description: A decentralized Swiss franc stablecoin, live since 2023, backed by collateral your users can inspect on-chain.

items.title: Savings for your users
items.description: Deposits in the savings module earn the protocol rate. Users keep custody and can withdraw any time.

items.title: Revenue sharing
items.description: Set your address as referrer when users deposit and receive up to 25% of their interest, paid by the contract. Users see the deduction and can remove the referrer.

why.chains: ZCHF is a standard ERC-20 (18 decimals) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Gnosis, Avalanche and Sonic, bridged with Chainlink CCIP.

items.title: List ZCHF
items.description: Add the token to your exchange or wallet. Addresses per chain, logos and supply endpoints are public.

items.title: Integrate savings
items.description: Call the savings contract with your referrer address and share. One deposit transaction for the user; interest starts three days later.

cta.title: Listing or integrating ZCHF?
cta.body: The association supports listings with liquidity introductions, co-marketing and technical help.
